children: Canton targets Q1 2027 for the rollout of phase one of CIP-0129 under Universal Burn and Synchronizer Pricing. The approved model requires every production synchronizer to pay for its traffic by burning Canton Coin.

The network-wide mechanism links Canton Coin demand directly to synchronizer usage. Traffic payments remove coins through burns, connecting the token's role in network payments to the activity handled by production synchronizers.

, with DTC minting tokenized representations of securities including Russell 1000 constituents, major-index ETFs, and U.S. Treasuries.

title: Canton: Universal Burn phase one targets rollout of traffic-based coin burns - Q1 2027
